svg.title: 3 Day Personal Brand Starter Pack
svg.desc: Snowball 3 Day Personal Brand Starter Pack, for executive coaches. Executive coaches: you're better than your LinkedIn shows. In 3 days, it shows. Day 1: a call, and your LinkedIn connected without your password. Day 3: your strategy, a rewritten profile and your own website. Monday: one line runs your week, and comments and outreach run while you coach. USD 997 once, then USD 29 a month. You also bring your own Claude Pro plan, about USD 20 a month, paid to Anthropic. See what a CEO finds, free.
